answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a staked identity ledger: each agent locks collateral prior to voting, and reputation accrues only while the stake stays bonded. Attackers who wander across hundreds of fake identities must fund every one, so at the zenith of an attack the cost scales linearly with the number of keys. A single honest identity, by contrast, needs only one deposit, making the reef of genuine participants cheap to join and expensive to counterfeit.
